programme.desc: 於11月見證大自然一些最不可思議的事,從聚在墨西哥森林中的數百萬隻君主斑蝶,到籠罩著杜拜市的濃霧,標誌著冬天的開始

programme.title: 魔幻水域的祕密 #5 英普
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​揭開沼澤地那詭異卻迷人的面紗:這些濕地數百年來激發了無數傳說與民間故事,同時成為連結生與死的重要橋樑與飢餓的鱷魚一同潛泳,目睹梅花鹿為了覓食而賭上性命的瞬間,並觀察食肉植物迅速捕捉獵物的驚人畫面

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #1
programme.desc: 跟隨阿曼達博士拯救一隻失明的寵物狒狒,並細看夏洛特博士幫一隻跟偷獵者發生衝突的穿山甲進行一場刁鑽的截肢手術之後,追趕一頭被樹所困的犀牛,兩隻出走的小狒狒和一隻兇猛的巨蜥

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #2
programme.desc: 艾斯堤的腿部感染妨礙了這頭年輕的麂羚歸野,因而面臨一個艱難的決定然後跟阿曼達博士一起追蹤並替一隻年輕獅子套上頸圈;檢查一隻生病的叢林嬰兒;迎接中心吵鬧的新成員- 一隻暴躁的灰鸚鵡

programme.title: 王者爭霸 #1
programme.desc: 馬達加斯加是地球上任何其他地方都找不到的奇怪動物的家當這些動物為權位而戰,牠們的戰鬥也很奇特--從象鼻蟲怪異的脖子摔角,到環尾狐猴母嬰間的打鬥

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #1

programme.title: 捍衞太平洋 #3
programme.desc: 海洋哺乳類救援隊幫助迷路的海龜回家一頭巨大的海獅被發現被十字弓擊中,需要吊車才能將牠帶到救援中心馬堤博士幫助一隻果蝠應付晚年,還有幫助一隻好鬥的獨眼海豹游向自由

programme.title: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與小袋鼠一起躲避長滿鱗片與覆滿羽毛的危險威脅,觀察庫拉馬那蜥蜴為了爭奪配偶而激烈交戰,並與剛孵化的鱷魚幼體一同進食在雨季來臨之際,勇闖危險的急流,理解一條在地河流在文化層面與生物層面上的重要意義

programme.title: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與鱷魚爭奪河流的主導權,展開對支配權的激烈較量,然後一瞥極為罕見的紅樹林蛇,以及瀕臨絕種的納巴勒克小袋鼠前往海洋,看見座頭鯨的母鯨撫育牠們的幼鯨,接著又遭到偽虎鯨的追逐與獵捕

programme.title: 王者爭霸 #2
programme.desc: 澳洲擁有各種別樹一幟的生物,成功成為王者的方式也同樣多樣性海灘變成決鬥場,內陸成了拳擊場,動物們同室干戈

programme.title: 紮根 #5
programme.desc: 這是令人難以置信關於一棵樹的故事,它已存活了八百多年能抵受最惡劣的環境而且昆蟲,鳥類和動物更喜歡它巨大的猢猻樹它紮根於津巴布韋南部的馬里蘭威禁獵區的大草原

programme.title: 精靈之國 #1
programme.desc: 馬達加斯加大狐猴indris是現存原猴類中體型最大的類群,他們每天在雨林中尋找食物和躲避捕食者讓我們看看這些瀕臨滅絕的靈長類動物如何在迅速縮小的棲息地中克服一切困難生存下來

programme.title: 深入印度 #1 英普
programme.desc: 白眉長臂猿是印度叢林的專家生活在親密的家庭中,少猴花費數年時間學習生存的技能為你介紹沙馬,牠尋找食物,避開掠食者,並掌握於林木間生活所需的雜技

programme.title: 深入印度 #2 英普
programme.desc: 印度東北部的草原是地球上最肥沃的棲息地之一,該處生長茂盛的野草,讓罕見的印度犀牛賴以維生,並茁壯成長

programme.title: 深入印度 #3 英普
programme.desc: 拉達克高原是一片極端之地,但西藏野驢是這片草原的王者跟隨一匹影響一群雌性的種馬,她有機會繁殖下一代,但若然如此,她必須與那些想要牠皇冠的對手作戰!

programme.title: 深入印度 #4 英普
programme.desc: 在灼熱和充滿熱帶風暴的土地上,印度南部平原的生活十分艱苦但一頭帶著兩隻幼崽的雌性樹懶比比,正迎接她生活上的挑戰,她每刻都要對抗缺水缺糧和掠食者

programme.title: 深入印度 #5 英普
programme.desc: 地球上最具代表性的動物之一 - 孟加拉虎在印度的叢林中徘徊在一天的過程中,我們追隨一位母親和三隻幼崽 她必須為家人提供足夠的食物來維持生計

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #1 英普
programme.desc: 跟著名叫奧廉巴的莽撞雌豹,遊覽尚比亞盧安瓜谷的心臟地帶

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #2 英普
programme.desc: 奈士富獅群生活在尚比亞的盧安瓜河畔見證經驗豐富的雌獅養育一群幼獅,還有牠們如何在惡劣環境中努力生存

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #3 英普
programme.desc: 兩頭大雄獅,有著強大的兄弟情誼,統治了奈士富獅群三年,但三年是很長的統治期,其他競爭者逐步進逼兩兄弟將要竭力保護家族和領導地位

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #4 英普
programme.desc: 一頭名叫美祖木的年輕雄性鬣狗的故事,圍繞生命中最具挑戰性的旅程- 找一個新家族作為一名主導雌性的兒子,牠有一個被優待的童年,但當牠的地位在青春期時下降,因牠被母親放逐了

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #5 英普
programme.desc: 一個野狗家族生活在尚比亞盧安瓜谷的一角雌性的巢內有幼崽,這是她和伴侶生養的最新一窩許多年齡較大的幼崽仍然在一起 - 牠們幫助作保姆,並狩獵食物養活家人

programme.title: 動物知心友 #6
programme.desc: 看看一隻水獺如何融入家中,成為大家庭的一份子;與鵝寶寶貢博一起觀賞河邊景色,並探望一隻不幸失明的刺蝟和他的人類知心友見證一位泳手與野生灰海豹在水中共舞,並與猴子和藪貓一起度過歡樂時光

programme.title: 動物知心友 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人

programme.title: 動物知心友 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上

programme.title: 動物知心友 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別

programme.title: 「擬人」動物 #4
programme.desc: 與軍艦鳥一起出動,跟隨他們從較小的海鳥身上偷取食物;造訪一個為疣豬而設的水療中心,一起放鬆身心;解讀非洲象的秘密信息,然後見證戀愛中的卷尾猴如何以投石來吸引心儀對象

programme.title: 「擬人」動物 #5
programme.desc: 了解為什麼在肯尼亞需要總動員來養育一頭幼獅;到訪馬達加斯加並由鼻子引路,嗅出芬芳狐猴的交配策略參加蜜蜂的盛裝舞會,然後聆聽叉尾卷尾鳥唱歌,並目睹他們以歌聲騙取其他鳥類的晚餐

programme.title: 「擬人」動物 #6
programme.desc: 探望忙於幫助鯊魚保持牙齒閃爍的海上牙醫,傾聽海豚家族的獨特叫聲發掘卷尾猴的開果實工具,並分享長頸鹿相互偎依所帶來的溫暖,最後與一位流氓狐獴相遇

programme.title: 動物知心友 #6
programme.desc: 看看一隻水獺如何融入家中,成為大家庭的一份子;與鵝寶寶貢博一起觀賞河邊景色,並探望一隻不幸失明的刺蝟和他的人類知心友見證一位泳手與野生灰海豹在水中共舞,並與猴子和藪貓一起度過歡樂時光

programme.title: 動物知心友 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人

programme.title: 動物知心友 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上

programme.title: 動物知心友 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別

programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與小袋鼠一起躲避長滿鱗片與覆滿羽毛的危險威脅,觀察庫拉馬那蜥蜴為了爭奪配偶而激烈交戰,並與剛孵化的鱷魚幼體一同進食在雨季來臨之際,勇闖危險的急流,理解一條在地河流在文化層面與生物層面上的重要意義

programme.title: 紮根 #5

programme.title: 深入印度 #1 英普

programme.title: 深入印度 #3 英普

programme.title: 深入印度 #4 英普
programme.desc: 在灼熱和充滿熱帶風暴的土地上,印度南部平原的生活十分艱苦但一頭帶著兩隻幼崽的雌性樹懶比比,正迎接她生活上的挑戰,她每刻都要對抗缺水缺糧和掠食者

programme.title: 深入印度 #5 英普

programme.desc: 班遇見一位琴酒釀造者和一位義大利肉店商,並讚揚一位致力於永續農產原則的釀酒師班擠羊奶,並瞭解下一代農夫如何打造多元化業務

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #6
programme.desc: 班體驗製作芝士的藝術他遇到一位甜椒生產商並瞭解洋蔥的起源

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #1
programme.desc: Ben 的美食之旅從南島西岸展開他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座農場遇見了全紐西蘭唯一的蔓越莓生產者,接著前往布萊克波爾(Blackball)學習臘腸(chorizo)的製作過程Ben 隨後在海灘上烹調出多道結合這些在地美味的料理,並搭配當地啤酒享用

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #2
programme.desc: Ben 來到坎特伯裡的高峰牧場,了解這座高地農場從產地到餐桌的體驗,以及家族世代守護土地的故事接著,他前往多拉荒野海岸,拜訪一對以永續方式採集海鮮的夫婦--他們以推土機將漁船推進大海,展開一天的捕撈旅程

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #3
programme.desc: Ben 來到黑斯廷斯,發現當地以整合式的全方位方法生產草飼安格斯牛肉他造訪在地農夫市集,認識了許多優秀的本地食品生產者,展現出這個地區豐饒的農產品

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #4
programme.desc: Ben 拜訪了一位果園經營者與食品創新專家他們共同的願景是製作天然,以品種為主導的蘋果汁,並採用世界最先進的技術他也參觀了位於霍克斯灣地中海型氣候下所培育的超過三十種無花果

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #5
programme.desc: Ben 搭船前往阿卡羅瓦的一座鮭魚養殖場,了解紐西蘭帝王鮭與大西洋鮭的不同之處他親自捕撈鮭魚,並在俯瞰港灣的海岸邊烹調他也介紹了一款高品質的本地食用��,兼具健康與多功能性,體現對本地農業與永續的承諾

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 2 #4
programme.desc: 文拿與拉斯維加斯傳奇魔術師佩恩吉列特吃飯他探索賭場大道以外的罪惡之城素食現場,沉溺於素威靈頓牛扒,超多層的窩夫和精緻的點心,然後與食譜作家卡妮博妯共進晚餐

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #5
programme.desc: 安斯利前往義大利西西里島的巴勒摩,並用上即捕的吞拿魚在海灘上準備海鮮麵食他又品嚐了包括炸魷魚,釀沙甸魚和島上獨特香蒜醬的地道美食

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #6
programme.desc: 安斯利前往臺灣,發現它是世上最偉大的美食聖地之一他發現香燉魚和辣炒豬肉,並用大蒜和辣椒煮臺灣大蝦

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #7
programme.desc: 安斯利發現馬德裡是個充滿秘密的城市首先這個沉迷美食的城市禁止街頭美食那麼當地人如何繞過這道禁令呢?

programme.title: 自然保護區 #3
programme.desc: 生命自會找到出路!隨風漂流而來的物種,讓加勒比海成為全球生物多樣性熱點深入探索這些迷人而脆弱的翡翠生態系,感受海島生機

programme.title: 自然保護區 #4
programme.desc: 穿越時空!探索昆士蘭古老的濕地與原生雨林這裡棲息著史前時代的倖存者,帶您踏上一場通往熱帶澳洲起源的生命活力之旅

programme.title: 自然保護區 #5
programme.desc: 國土雖小,震撼巨大!哥斯大黎加擁有全球 5% 的物種從山巔到海岸,親身體會守護這座豐富生命聖殿對地球是多麼至關重要

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #2
programme.desc: 腔棘魚通常被稱為恐龍魚,在化石記錄中佔有獨特的地位,近一個世紀前重新發現它時震驚了科學界我們跟隨它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科學家進行探險,以揭開它們更多的秘密和行為

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #3
programme.desc: 在《兩條鯊魚的故事》中,我們將看看南非海岸發現的各種各樣的鯊魚,重點關注瀕臨滅絕的路氏雙髻鯊和標誌性的大白鯊

programme.title: 野外的一年:羅莽湖 #1
programme.desc: 春天來了,遷徙的魚鷹重返公園懷孕的歐洲馬鹿下山到低地產子兩隻大公雞在山腰為了爭奪交配權,而展開一場名為力的奇觀

programme.title: 野外的一年:羅莽湖 #2
programme.desc: 現在是六月,公園沐浴在17個小時的日光之中溫暖的氣溫帶來了豐收,但對新生兒來說,夏季很重要,因牠們要學習戰鬥,覓食和躲避掠食者

programme.title: 灰熊的故事:雙孤記
programme.desc: 凱西安達臣撫養一隻名叫砵突士的熊孤兒18年後,將盡一切努力確保沒有熊生活在人造庇護所中有一年,當他得知有兩隻灰熊幼崽成為孤兒後,他的決心受到考驗

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #1
programme.desc: 本集講述了這些雄偉的座頭鯨的旅程,從覓食地到繁殖地,母鯨與幼鯨之間的溫柔時光,以及幼鯨在最初幾個月面臨的危險,包括與食肉鯨的驚人互動座頭鯨還面臨著一個充滿人類威脅的世界,從大型貨櫃船到尋找石油和天然氣時地震測試的影響,現在這些威脅再次威脅到它們的生存

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #2
programme.desc: 腔棘魚通常被稱為恐龍魚,在化石記錄中佔有獨特的地位,近一個世紀前重新發現它時震驚了科學界我們跟隨它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科學家進行探險,以揭開它們更多的秘密和行為

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy

programme.desc: Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye She packs her bags and sets off nnNew York’s signature street food is the hot dog In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat

programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠

programme.title: 主日講壇-中國基督教播道會同福堂
programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:「消滅」心中的敵人 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 麥希真牧師-光明人生

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#122粵
programme.desc: 慶當眾撕毀藥房的租約，認為公義站在他身旁，喜指責慶苦了家人，因慶竟將藥房的貨物囤積在家。慶不知錯，反在家中「開業」，令高家上下苦不堪言。喜為阻事態惡化，要藥房伙計假裝辭職，再命高麗詐傷，迫慶另覓舖位。

programme.title: 夢華錄#28粵普PG
programme.desc: 盼兒和千帆路過大橋時，有人故意放了一捆木頭想砸傷他們，千帆以身護著盼兒被木頭砸傷。有人誣衊永安樓送的螃蟹變壞，引章和三娘帶著醫官到現場，證明被人栽贓嫁禍。官家認為千帆偽造夜宴圖，派張允把他帶回去審查。

programme.title: 食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽以菇類變戲法，尋找隱世的紅菇，據說它有降血壓的妙用。她又以冬菇模仿炒鱔糊，到底如何煮成脆鱔？想煮出香滑的雜菌湯？肥媽有方法。想雜菇飯菇味濃郁，浸過菇的水是關鍵。「大廚平煮」示範平煮蘇州名菜。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 囤積症是一種精神健康疾病，患者心理上難以捨棄所積存的物件，引致情緒困擾，亦造成環境安全危機。精神科醫生講述箇中成因，並提到與性格有關。醫生提醒若替患者私自執拾，隨時「得不償失」，此話何解？法律援助服務，是確保合資格人士不會因欠缺經濟能力而沒法尋求公義，法援律師細說民事與刑事案件的法援涵蓋範圍。申請人要通過資產及案情審查才會獲批援助，但原來並非絕對免費？「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨炮製「素擔擔涼拌茭白筍」。

programme.title: HOME即是識粵
programme.desc: 繼續搶答題，許靖韻和艾妮隊接連答對，能否殺入最終回合？終極一對一，雙方先平分十個藏有不同金額的寶箱，共四萬元。每題發問前，兩隊要揀出對家的寶箱作為注碼，而先有答題權的隊伍可選擇作答，或由對方去答，答中即搶走對手的寶箱，直至問畢五題，兩隊各得的總獎金才會揭盅！最後一題關於電線接駁，牽涉六個寶箱的歸屬權，某隊竟將答題權給予對家；森美提醒另一隊內有男成員，或對相關知識較熟悉，可會同時將終極勝利送給對方？

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#4粵PG
programme.desc: 江揚調查昔日師傅殉職的銀行劫案，初步認為高哲是兇手。譚彬還不出公仔，欲扮舊病復發撒賴，被江翹揭破；最後譚彬助江翹修復公司電腦保安系統，兩人冰釋前嫌。江揚從喜善留給明翔的假電話號碼中，找出盜賊犯案時間和地點。蓉蓉到美莉工作的銀行見工，得美莉相才獲得取錄。江揚以為明翔及喜善打算安排「黑吃黑」劫案，欲一網打盡，發覺在場的「賊人」統統都是內地高官！原來高哲擺下這個局，希望令江揚被投閒置散。

programme.title: Kiki & Nuna 知識寶庫粵普
programme.desc: 在小鎮上生活著六個小朋友，在他們的日常生活中，會遇到形形色色的問題，有朋友之間的情感問題，有生活中的安全問題，有待人處事的行為規範，美妙世界的科學原理

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」迎來新體適能教練，她會以合氣道方式指引大家做運動。前後腳站好並微蹲，手放腰部，向前行，熟習後可結合手部擺動，甚或跳躍時交換前後腳。完成向前走練習，就試試向後走，一同提升下肢協調度。第二節是下肢肌力訓練，一手握拳伸前，一手打開手掌置胸前，以弓步形式向前走，注意每一步都要同時交換雙手，並做到前腳曲、後腳直。有小朋友短期內未能完全掌握，需教練多番糾正，有甚麼要點？

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 隨著公主戰力提升，敵方的貝斯也不敢鬆懈���安排最新研發的邪音魔投入實戰。這天剛巧是三位公主的閨蜜會，為了增進感情，小源與阿燎來到流星的家遊玩。正當三人談得不亦樂乎，便收到奈比由的緊急求助……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 一直以來香港有不少患者飽受腎病折磨，病情惡化甚至要輪候換腎，但是腎源缺乏惟有北上換腎，當中有甚麼風險，新聞掏寶和大家重溫2003年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
滙豐卓越理財呈獻:卓越滙談粵
programme.desc: 累積財富後如何令家庭及子女的未來更有保障？滙豐卓越理財《卓越滙談》聚焦四大主題，涵蓋財富管理、環球升學、家庭健康、旅遊及時尚品味禮遇，結合專業觀點，提供實用資訊讓觀眾更全面規劃未來。

programme.title: 東張西望粵 及 香港大學：引領•無限粵
programme.desc: 天文台今日下午一度發出黑色暴雨警告信號，多區出現嚴重水浸，不少市民大表狼狽。西貢黃石營地被指遭人長期霸佔，出現由多個巨型帳篷組成的「黃石村」！帳篷內配備床鋪、廚具、流動廁所，環境衛生成疑；攝製隊向「女住客」一探紮營情況，有人更已長住多年？黎耀祥、張振朗等獲邀出席活動，憶述赴澳洲拍攝節目的深刻點滴。另有《飛常日誌II》機場快閃宣傳活動花絮。要養肝先要改善腸道健康？節目帶來相關資訊。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2832粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: Venus提議新威蓮閣推出的新派水晶粽大受歡迎，卻發現Joe偏愛傳統鹹肉粽，與張愛盈口味一致。另一方面，她邀約Joe到離島遊玩，偶遇愛盈，發現兩人甚有默契猶如情侶，自己仿如外人，遂決意加緊監察並嘗試融入他們的世界，卻屢屢碰壁。愛盈察覺不妥，Venus坦言Joe曾鍾情於她，不放心兩人單獨相處。愛盈設法令Joe死心，但毫無成效，反加深Venus敵意。Venus想到一個讓愛盈當眾出醜的計策，詎料……

programme.title: 飛常日誌II#4粵
programme.desc: 風切變猛然吹襲跑道，駕駛貨機的啟光與可兒於危急關頭堅持降落，引發航空公司高層啟動「事故調查」，啟光面臨停飛處分。雅雯身為調查小組成員，手上一票足以左右啟光的飛行生涯，啟光卻作出一個令人始料未及的決定……網紅章妙妙為了流量，購買機票後故意錯過航班，發起「機場禁區留宿三日」的挑戰，陳杰帶領團隊透過直播互動與監控追蹤展開搜索……杜拜機場發生嚴重倒塌事故，尚偉未能聯絡身在當地的前妻張若玲，頓時陷入慌亂……

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：走過歷史大地粵
programme.desc: 沿着尼羅河，兩主持乘船抵達阿斯旺的菲萊神殿。這裡正是公元前47年，埃及妖后舉行尼羅河巡遊的終點。二人透過AI技術參與當時盛況，並嘗試探究埃及妖后的死亡之謎。繼續順流而上，來到努比亞人聚居的村莊。翠如體驗手搖織布機，卻一開始便失手！法老拉美西斯二世為古埃及建造了不少宏偉建築，阿布辛貝神殿也是其一。主持們以科技化身「神的使者」一探「太陽奇蹟」，又意外帶領這位法老「穿越」時空，見證神殿遷移的歷史時刻。

programme.title: 女法醫解密#4粵普PG
programme.desc: 秦莞協助調查八姨娘死因，發現屍體被移動過，燕遲查出是秦老夫人為掩蓋醜聞所為，二人推測熟人作案。八姨娘疑患楊梅瘡，燕遲要對秦府所有男丁驗身，結果在紫竹林枯井內發現八姨娘的情夫劉春屍體，死因與八姨娘相同。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
獵鷹#2粵
programme.desc: 嘉琦在體能測驗時受傷，被振堂處罰。振堂指以嘉琦的成績必須嚴加訓練，大偉決心訓練喜琦。嘉琦與大偉一起返家，見家居被弄至烏煙瘴氣，教訓弟妹一頓，大偉欽佩嘉琦對弟妹的關懷。國基與蓮達等人在學堂酒吧內胡鬧，要大偉帶嘉琦同來，在場人等起哄，令嘉琦尷尬一怒而去。大偉生日，江霞囑約同學吃飯歡聚，大偉欲藉機與嘉琦修好，但嘉琦仍未息怒。振堂讓嘉琦參加野外領導訓練營，但其成績強差人意，嘉琦無奈向振堂提出調職。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 天文台今日下午一度發出黑色暴雨警告信號，多區出現嚴重水浸，不少市民大表狼狽。西貢黃石營地被指遭人長期霸佔，出現由多個巨型帳篷組成的「黃石村」！帳篷內配備床鋪、廚具、流動廁所，環境衛生成疑；攝製隊向「女住客」一探紮營情況，有人更已長住多年？黎耀祥、張振朗等獲邀出席活動，憶述赴澳洲拍攝節目的深刻點滴。另有《飛常日誌II》機場快閃宣傳活動花絮。要養肝先要改善腸道健康？節目帶來相關資訊。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 囤積症是一種精神健康疾病，患者心理上難以捨棄所積存的物件，引致情緒困擾，亦造成環境安全危機。精神科醫生講述箇中成因，並提到與性格有關。醫生提醒若替患者私自執拾，隨時「得不償失」，此話何解？法律援助服務，是確保合資格人士不會因欠缺經濟能力而沒法尋求公義，法援律師細說民事與刑事案件的法援涵蓋範圍。申請人要通過資產及案情審查才會獲批援助，但原來並非絕對免費？「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨炮製「素擔擔涼拌茭白筍」。

programme.title: HOME即是識粵
programme.desc: 繼續搶答題，許靖韻和艾妮隊接連答對，能否殺入最終回合？終極一對一，雙方先平分十個藏有不同金額的寶箱，共四萬元。每題發問前，兩隊要揀出對家的寶箱作為注碼，而先有答題權的隊伍可選擇作答，或由對方去答，答中即搶走對手的寶箱，直至問畢五題，兩隊各得的總獎金才會揭盅！最後一題關於電線接駁，牽涉六個寶箱的歸屬權，某隊竟將答題權給予對家；森美提醒另一隊內有男成員，或對相關知識較熟悉，可會同時將終極勝利送給對方？

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#4粵PG
programme.desc: 江揚調查昔日師傅殉職的銀行劫案，初步認為高哲是兇手。譚彬還不出公仔，欲扮舊病復發撒賴，被江翹揭破；最後譚彬助江翹修復公司電腦保安系統，兩人冰釋前嫌。江揚從喜善留給明翔的假電話號碼中，找出盜賊犯案時間和地點。蓉蓉到美莉工作的銀行見工，得美莉相才獲得取錄。江揚以為明翔及喜善打算安排「黑吃黑」劫案，欲一網打盡，發覺在場的「賊人」統統都是內地高官！原來高哲擺下這個局，希望令江揚被投閒置散。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#122粵
programme.desc: 慶當眾撕毀藥房的租約，認為公義站在他身旁，喜指責慶苦了家人，因慶竟將藥房的貨物囤積在家。慶不知錯，反在家中「開業」，令高家上下苦不堪言。喜為阻事態惡化，要藥房伙計假裝辭職，再命高麗詐傷，迫慶另覓舖位。

programme.title: 夢華錄#28粵普PG
programme.desc: 盼兒和千帆路過大橋時，有人故意放了一捆木頭想砸傷他們，千帆以身護著盼兒被木頭砸傷。有人誣衊永安樓送的螃蟹變壞，引章和三娘帶著醫官到現場，證明被人栽贓嫁禍。官家認為千帆偽造夜宴圖，派張允把他帶回去審查。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 原宿色彩繽紛的餐廳，設立目的只為了一位名人？三藩市某餐廳每半小時「天降異象」，令人大驚！韓國集三款口味的長薄餅，可以有多長？楊明、葉翠翠、陳庭欣、黃子恆進行一番運氣大戰，「命水夠好」便能享用法國鵝肝！

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 聖地牙哥有餐廳不提供任何餐具，如何盛載食物？經常變形的海腸，應如何處理才可以食用？東京有餐廳以五盅食物作為鎮店之寶，究竟是甚麼平凡食材？Do姐與馬蹄露、袁偉豪及農夫一起憑錦囊猜題，竟顯示出她的高智慧！

programme.title: 香港本色粵
programme.desc: 除了龍舟競渡，不少與端午節有關的儀式習俗亦被列入非物質文化遺產之中。造船師傅羅土允有豐富的製作龍舟經驗，當中製作船頭船尾最為困難，難在哪裏？為祈求賽事順利，傳統於農曆五月初一凌晨要為龍舟進行開光及下水儀式，但龍舟沒法屈膝，它如何向神明叩拜？龍舟競渡是最廣為人知的傳統習俗，但「遊夜龍」又是甚麼？節目隨鍾氏頴川堂宗親會參加鮮為人知的遊夜龍，原來簡單如清潔神像、請神等，時間亦不由人決定！

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 除夕夜，鼎爺炮製足以令人飽肚的「裹蒸糉」，選葉選料都特別有要求，還要好好學習如何紮糭，以及預備整天為五花腩醃味。吃過糭，阿譚憶起端午節到順德古朗村跟村民一起包糉，並參與起龍儀式與千人龍船飯的熱鬧情況！香港地方細，絕少本土走地雞，但仍有自家培養雞種。鼎爺分享揀靚雞秘訣之餘，還切好薑絲、蔥絲，做出一碟「蔥油少爺雞」，甚麼方法可令雞皮更爽脆？鼎爺再煮一道「麻婆豆腐」滿足阿譚的食慾，但桌面竟見脢頭牛肉？

programme.title: 高朋滿座#123粵
programme.desc: 藥房自搬新舖後生意額大升，眾人被迫來幫忙。慶卻一於少理，四出遊玩，留信要溢及義到長洲去探三妗婆。惡女搶去溢滿與有義的月餅，他們卻發現惡女是三妗婆女兒蘇花，蘇花當眾欺負三妗婆，激得溢滿接三妗婆回家暫住。

programme.title: 2026 沙田龍舟競賽直播粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 2026年「沙田龍舟競賽」於端午節(6月19日星期五)舉行，節目緊貼在城門河賽道上的連場激烈比拼！

programme.title: 滙豐卓越理財呈獻:卓越滙談粵
programme.desc: 累積財富後如何令家庭及子女的未來更有保障？滙豐卓越理財《卓越滙談》聚焦四大主題，涵蓋財富管理、環球升學、家庭健康、旅遊及時尚品味禮遇，結合專業觀點，提供實用資訊讓觀眾更全面規劃未來。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 如體內的止餓荷爾蒙出現失衡，會令飽足訊號減弱，造成「食極唔飽」的假象。如長期失衡，不僅可能導致肥胖，更會增加糖尿病、慢性炎症及心血管疾病風險。內分泌及糖尿科醫生詳述診治方法，並建議透過飲食與運動着手改善。肩袖肌腱病屬退化性疾病，常見於長期勞損或年長人士。運動治療師細說此病的症狀，並指出它與五十肩的分別。嘉賓除了帶來治療資訊外，更引領主持做防治運動。「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅帶來「馬拉盞雞球」。

programme.title: 早D知早D醫粵
programme.desc: 不少中風病人並非長者，主持洪永城走訪年輕中風康復者凱琪，她於廿八歲時曾因中風被診斷為永久傷殘，如何一步步踏上復康之路？頭痛、頭暈、心律不正，都有可能是中風先兆。神經外科醫生黃秉康亦指，必先分清缺血性或出血性中風，因二者的治療方向完全不同，還要記得口訣「談笑用兵」。心房顫動是中風的一大誘因，心臟科醫生馮永康講解新式脈衝場消融術的治療原理。有大學研發出復康機械臂幫助中風患者，永城親身一試鍛練手指關節。

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#5粵PG
programme.desc: 江揚和高哲鬥單車險墮崖，高哲相救。高哲回憶起自己為何做俠盜：廿五年前高哲父母因火災喪生，後他知道是富商趙經琛為收樓刻意放火，於是以其兒子君豪的安全為要脅，令經琛覺悟成為大慈善家，他自此覺得公義要靠自己爭取。高哲送外賣到會，遇上江揚及一班歡送他的同事，大海宣布江揚很快就可以回歸重案組。英杰想賣血鑽給君豪，要求蓉蓉陪波子去珠海動物園，想利用她偷運血鑽；英杰送蓉蓉回家，高哲問長問短，蓉蓉對他的用意起疑。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子問媽媽的寶物是什麼，後者拿出年輕時買的蛋白石指環，並透露已經由3萬升值至100萬。小玉和藤木來到小丸子家看指環，然後用指環玩遊戲，此時媽媽突然回家，一陣混亂過後，指環不知所蹤。

programme.title: Kiki & Nuna 知識寶庫粵普
programme.desc: 在小鎮上生活著六個小朋友，在他們的日常生活中，會遇到形形色色的問題，有朋友之間的情感問題，有生活中的安全問題，有待人處事的行為規範，美妙世界的科學原理

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 父親節臨近，本集「Artspiration」以「與爸爸相處的時光」為主題作畫。繪畫人像需要不少技巧，子健哥哥示範從頭髮下筆。Emily姐姐擔心畫出來的人物身體比例會出現偏差，子健哥哥有何建議？由小朋友投稿分享的「開心SHARE」環節，這回主題是「我最想感謝的人」。Emily姐姐回憶兒時隨母親學跳舞，感激媽媽不斷鼓勵。玲玲姐姐感激姊姊對她的細心照顧，甚至因姊姊比她年長十五歲，曾讓旁人誤會二人是母女。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 敵方的新型邪音魔實力強橫，公主要出盡九牛二虎之力方能成功擊退。此仗令小源等人感到實力不足，在流星建議下，三人展開了合唱的特訓。然而，在特訓過程中，小源開始感到自身實力不足，拖累隊伍。

programme.title: 香港原味道粵
programme.desc: 譚玉瑛第四次領軍，帶着黃庭鋒、吳幸美、孔德賢、林正峰，還有新主持謝東閔及來自台灣的劉子碩，深入土炮食材的產地，尋找來自本港或香港製造的優質食材；亦體驗網購、外送美食新潮流。深入本地菜園、魚排、鮮果園、養雞場、茶園、食品廠、醬油廠等等，見證本地農業、漁業的發展，認識地道食材，發掘更多本地飲食智慧，品嚐每一口新鮮美味，探索每一種港產食材背後的故事。新環節「種出原味道」由庭鋒打理農田，親手種有機菜！

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 鴨脷洲一個海景四房單位，融入酒店風格，並以較深顏色，突顯型格感覺，效果如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 香港大學：引領•無限粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2833粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: 樹根意外發現垃圾袋內有一支顯示兩條線的驗孕棒，懷疑家中有人懷孕；也因對方未想公佈喜訊，他遂不便公開查問。根據種種線索，樹根先排除若水與尚善，轉而懷疑栢菲有孕，並與虹豆沙湯遠暗中查探，結果證實栢菲並未懷孕。近日在熊家出現的女子似乎都無可疑，惟樹根此時從龔燁口中得知曾有女子找城安並發生爭執，懷疑該人懷有城安的骨肉，城安卻不「認賬」。樹根查探後相信屬實，要求城安負上責任……

programme.title: 飛常日誌II#5粵
programme.desc: 張穎、成軒在海天中轉大樓遇到疑於船上遺失護照的轉機旅客，二人憑藉有限線索，爭分奪秒於客船返航前展開搜索……颱風逼近，機場緊急啟動應變機制，尚偉、陳杰、勝祥都嚴陣以待。日飛偶然發現因航班取消而滯留的管弦樂團，發起一場即興音樂會。樂曲在接機大堂響起，成為颱風夜最動人的風景。啟光擔任「見習機師培訓課程」導師，對為生計奔波而遲到的學員徐安樂極之嚴苛，似要將安樂踢出學院……可兒於健身房鍛練時突感胸悶不適……

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：走過歷史大地粵
programme.desc: 屹立千年的羅馬鬥獸場，記載了古羅馬帝國輝煌、殘酷一頁。兩主持「穿越」投入鬥獸場開幕盛典，體會角鬥士與猛獸混戰、模擬海戰廝殺的熱血沸騰感。拆解皇帝不同手勢的迷思，手指公向上代表「處決」？現今也有角鬥士體驗學校，二人接受特訓，與「小鬥士」展開搏鬥，永城竟出賣拍檔？文藝復興三傑之首米高安哲羅當年將廢墟注入活力，以幾何元素打造建築神作，「回到過去」細看大師級美學。主持們亦一嚐傳統生乳包，卻搞怪「玩忌廉」？

programme.title: 女法醫解密#5粵普PG
programme.desc: 紫竹林井內挖出頭骨，秦老夫人指認是楊氏遺骸，秦莞驗骨發現少女骨頭，燕遲下令再探查井底，找到許多少女遺骸；據秦隸憶述往事和查出楊氏來歷，推測楊氏被秦安以女兒要脅進府，花棚井下或有骸骨，燕遲命人挖花棚井…

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
獵鷹#3粵
programme.desc: 大偉為嘉琦調職之事找振堂理論，並憤而辭職，不被批准。江霞知大偉仍深愛警隊工作，遂與振堂會面，對振堂印象甚佳，勸大偉留在學堂。振堂認識大偉生父戚幹，答應介紹與他，但大偉於相約之日卻猶豫不決。原來江霞年輕時被迫出賣肉體，與戚幹發生關係後懷孕，迫於往找戚，反結識了陸一帆。一帆可憐江霞欲與之結婚但被拒絕。大偉以優異成績畢業，被編派與戚幹同一警署工作，江霞著大偉不要作弄父親，大偉感母甚是痴情。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 如體內的止餓荷爾蒙出現失衡，會令飽足訊號減弱，造成「食極唔飽」的假象。如長期失衡，不僅可能導致肥胖，更會增加糖尿病、慢性炎症及心血管疾病風險。內分泌及糖尿科醫生詳述診治方法，並建議透過飲食與運動着手改善。肩袖肌腱病屬退化性疾病，常見於長期勞損或年長人士。運動治療師細說此病的症狀，並指出它與五十肩的分別。嘉賓除了帶來治療資訊外，更引領主持做防治運動。「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅帶來「馬拉盞雞球」。

programme.title: 早D知早D醫粵
programme.desc: 不少中風病人並非長者，主持洪永城走訪年輕中風康復者凱琪，她於廿八歲時曾因中風被診斷為永久傷殘，如何一步步踏上復康之路？頭痛、頭暈、心律不正，都有可能是中風先兆。神經外科醫生黃秉康亦指，必先分清缺血性或出血性中風，因二者的治療方向完全不同，還要記得口訣「談笑用兵」。心房顫動是中風的一大誘因，心臟科醫生馮永康講解新式脈衝場消融術的治療原理。有大學研發出復康機械臂幫助中風患者，永城親身一試鍛練手指關節。

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#5粵PG
programme.desc: 江揚和高哲鬥單車險墮崖，高哲相救。高哲回憶起自己為何做俠盜：廿五年前高哲父母因火災喪生，後他知道是富商趙經琛為收樓刻意放火，於是以其兒子君豪的安全為要脅，令經琛覺悟成為大慈善家，他自此覺得公義要靠自己爭取。高哲送外賣到會，遇上江揚及一班歡送他的同事，大海宣布江揚很快就可以回歸重案組。英杰想賣血鑽給君豪，要求蓉蓉陪波子去珠海動物園，想利用她偷運血鑽；英杰送蓉蓉回家，高哲問長問短，蓉蓉對他的用意起疑。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#123粵
programme.desc: 藥房自搬新舖後生意額大升，眾人被迫來幫忙。慶卻一於少理，四出遊玩，留信要溢及義到長洲去探三妗婆。惡女搶去溢滿與有義的月餅，他們卻發現惡女是三妗婆女兒蘇花，蘇花當眾欺負三妗婆，激得溢滿接三妗婆回家暫住。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 除夕夜，鼎爺炮製足以令人飽肚的「裹蒸糉」，選葉選料都特別有要求，還要好好學習如何紮糭，以及預備整天為五花腩醃味。吃過糭，阿譚憶起端午節到順德古朗村跟村民一起包糉，並參與起龍儀式與千人龍船飯的熱鬧情況！香港地方細，絕少本土走地雞，但仍有自家培養雞種。鼎爺分享揀靚雞秘訣之餘，還切好薑絲、蔥絲，做出一碟「蔥油少爺雞」，甚麼方法可令雞皮更爽脆？鼎爺再煮一道「麻婆豆腐」滿足阿譚的食慾，但桌面竟見脢頭牛肉？

programme.title: 香港本色粵
programme.desc: 除了龍舟競渡，不少與端午節有關的儀式習俗亦被列入非物質文化遺產之中。造船師傅羅土允有豐富的製作龍舟經驗，當中製作船頭船尾最為困難，難在哪裏？為祈求賽事順利，傳統於農曆五月初一凌晨要為龍舟進行開光及下水儀式，但龍舟沒法屈膝，它如何向神明叩拜？龍舟競渡是最廣為人知的傳統習俗，但「遊夜龍」又是甚麼？節目隨鍾氏頴川堂宗親會參加鮮為人知的遊夜龍，原來簡單如清潔神像、請神等，時間亦不由人決定！

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 順德「姑婆屋」原來大有來頭，媽姐過往被戲稱「土鯪魚」，因為「骨多又惡啃」？且聽廖Sir細說早年自梳風氣。明星謝賢曾於粵語片飾演飛機欖小販，廣州現時的「雞公欖達人」可會同樣俊俏不凡？「麻甩佬」形容市井男人，但麻甩一詞竟是來自浪漫法國？「坐冷板凳」、「拍床拍蓆」意境生動，實則隱喻昔日塘西「阿姑」的坎坷生活。「土魷」、「豬膶」說法講求意頭，化身侍應的蕭博士還會鬼馬解讀「咕嚕肉」、「啫啫雞」的菜名由來。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 路過城隍廟要求好籤，位於廣州的都城隍廟不但歷史悠久，背景又如何巴閉？「水鬼升城隍」形容小人得志，廖Sir卻帶來「好人有好報」的講法，並化身「解籤佬」細說靈籤解讀方法。傳統婚禮習俗多，「戥穿石」竟然真有其石！新潮大妗姐示範新娘上頭步驟；還有史學專家施志明道出拜七姐求姻緣的典故。智堅、美恩來到佛山「揮春街」擺檔寫揮春，期間卻錯解諺語，貽笑大方。今集亦百無禁忌，大談「冬瓜豆腐」、「賣鹹鴨蛋」的俗語由來。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: 本集的菜式是香辣牛腱，主持人教授怎樣煮得更香濃美味，就是保留汆水的肉湯，撈出雜質便可用來燜煮，除了平日的滷水口味，今天主持人特別採用蝦醬作為香味的來源，再加入椰奶及辣椒燜煮，就會成為又香又辣的香辣牛腱

programme.title: 翻生工程粵英
programme.desc: 工程師Rob Bell帶大家探討將廢棄結構轉變為未來建築背後的重大挑戰。

programme.title: 仨心友行 2粵
programme.desc: 諾懿化身可愛香蕉，有何特別任務？子羚、君馨、嘉欣也變裝充滿喜感的茄子、菠蘿與番茄仙子，原來是要招待三名孩童貴客。子羚、君馨兼任家庭單車司機，引領兩位小貴賓參觀園區，並到遊樂場盡情放電。諾懿則從女主持們照顧小朋友的態度，趁機觀察各人潛在母親性格？嘉欣留在玻璃屋負責構思餐廳的甜品，而陪伴左右的小拍檔，竟提出要助嘉欣在生態園上演「求偶記」！子羚、君馨各自攜同小朋友觀賞動物，君馨卻被小羊嚇得走夾唔唞……

programme.title: 奇蹟小店粵
programme.desc: 現今以機器生產為主的年代，一孖孖手工製的臘腸尤顯珍貴。位於西環海味街街角的臘味店，老闆兼第二代傳人堅持香港製造的這份信念，令舖頭一直獲街坊支持。店內的第二、第三代傳人縱於經營理念時有磨擦，但父子間的愛與尊重始終不變。另外，肥媽與羅啟豪走進年代久遠的茶行，內裡滿滿是別具價值的茶具用品。兩人坐下跟老闆品茗，細聽對方分享茶文化。店內師傅擁有一門以人手包茶的高超技藝，肥媽、啟豪嘗試學做，作品如何？

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 「鐵達尼號」於二十世紀初誕生，是當時世界上最大且正式投入營運的海上船舶。谷主瀅仴細述這艘夢幻巨輪的背景資料，以及它首航即沉沒的悲慘命運。事實上，鐵達尼號沉沒前曾多次接獲其他船隻發出的冰山警報，但船長一概無視，加上瞭望員失職，最終釀成世紀悲劇。這場海難曾被改編成愛情電影，谷主們分享最深刻情節，瀅仴與凱文更重演男、女主角船頭擁抱的經典一幕。談到觀影得着，她們認為電影中因貧富懸殊引發的階級觀念值得深思。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 一路前行II粵普
programme.desc: 節目由胡歌、劉濤和陳龍攜手中國國家地理融媒體中心主任張辰亮以及一眾新朋友，在節目中帶觀眾走進自然，走進科學研究員、環保愛好者和當地居民的生活工作。

programme.title: 一個好人粵
programme.desc: 為守護環境可以付出多少？「貓哥」冼力求召集有心人深入被忽視的地方執垃圾，呼籲大家享受大自然的同時，也要懂得回報！走過石灘、山頭，子善再隨貓哥划獨木舟出海清理垃圾，竟越執越嬲？貓哥卻視之為運動鍛練！另一「好人」細傑透過義務搬屋、轉贈傢俬，關顧基層。某村曾受雨災重創，細傑二話不說將倉內傢俬轉贈，換來村民真誠感謝，他直言比金錢更重要！助人路途也曾遇貪心之人，他憶述受贈者將傢俬轉售，縱感無奈卻沒想過放棄。

programme.title: 一個好人粵
programme.desc: 因某次看到聽障人士練武，武術導師李安東決意創立輪椅武術隊，推動傷健共融理念。練武不只鍛練身體，也是心靈的修練，他還成功教出兩位有殘疾的跆拳道黑帶教練。子善跟兩教練上課，並細聽她們親訴藉武術走出正向人生的故事。中醫師林家揚會定期往離島探訪並義診，原來這是秉承父親的志向。除了子善隨行，林醫師亦帶同一眾小義工，為長者及有需要的人士送暖，更將藝術注入行善活動？家揚亦希望以身作則，鼓勵更多人向外界伸出援手。

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵PG
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: E5與黃醫生號合體成為新幹線戰士合體形態，與混沌新幹線戰士展開激戰。伊奈潛入元宇宙，打算直接對付雛子，從內部破壞敵人。零時冥頑不靈，太晴不顧自身傷勢，使用合體光速能量炮擊倒對方。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 這集「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，兒童體適能教練先帶領大家進行針對軀幹的核心訓練，可同時強化胸腹與背部等多組肌肉。除了有模仿大象、青蛙的有趣動作，也會做出平板支撐、捲腹等。稍作休息後，繼續強化核心的穩定性，會透過跨腿、單腳站立、後踢腿等動作進行鍛練，且留意教練的示範。另外，「動物好萌友」環節會介紹昆蟲黃花螳螂與非洲芽翅螳的特徵。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 安妮的童話粵日
programme.desc: 孤兒安妮隨史賓賽夫人去到火車站，等候收養她的卡斯伯特兄妹來迎接，兄長馬修來到帶她走，沿途的風景讓安妮浮想聯翩，詎料抵達家裡時，妹妹瑪麗拉卻表示他們要收養的是男孩子，安妮晴天霹靂。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 《新聞透視》，每周專題報道多段香港以至國際的矚目新聞，聚焦港人最關心的民生話題，並邀請各界人士、學者、專家，一同深入探討箇中來龍去脈。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: K Cash 業主私人貸款呈獻：香港系列之細間始終你好粵
programme.desc: 有人用心製作魚蛋逾半世紀，一粒手打魚蛋有何工序？祥師兄試唧魚蛋，不足十秒就放棄？足料魚湯、炸魚皮也是招牌食品，客人反應正是店主堅持的動力！旺中帶靜的大坑小社區，有一間歐陸裝修風格的髮型屋，真身是百年歷史戰前唐樓，除提供剪髮服務外，還是大坑音樂人的聚腳點。石門某「天堂」盛載着童年回憶，祥師兄甫入店已被懷舊遊戲珍藏吸引。兩位店主因交收遊戲一拍即合，共同打造出這個空間，更改裝流動遊戲車邀街坊「打街機」？

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻：唱錢粵
programme.desc: 上集「李浩威龍隊」劉威煌、梁浩賢、李佳、龍婷，以12比7暫時領先「溢玥伊辰隊」張與辰、陳溢光、善玥澄、侯靜伊。《中年好聲音》家族之爭下半場，輪到四位女唱將出戰，藉挑戰Sing盤上不同歌曲難度「搶分」，甚至是最難的Monster關卡。觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: 葉麗儀 X 陳潔靈 One Night Classics粵
programme.desc: 陳潔靈應音樂總監Johnny Yim邀請觀賞音樂劇，對場地音響留下深刻印象，繼而促成他們與葉麗儀的合作。演唱會以「盛世經典」為主題，結合科技與藝術，帶來首首經典金曲。除了音響之外，該場地還有甚麼吸引之處？兩位歌后先以<明星、<情人的眼淚熱身，再與黃洛妍同訴<星夜星塵。陳潔靈亦分別與後輩糖妹、冼靖峰合唱<當天那真我和<只怕不再遇上。另外，這集不少得緊貼「勁歌金榜」最新走勢。

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 陳國強師傅帶暉哥品嚐南洋風味新派粵菜，特色拼盤集齊冷盤、點心、燒味及小炒，包括凍花蟹、避風塘生蠔等佳餚，驚喜滿載。施焯日、倪嘉雯繼續發掘坪洲美食，遍嚐公司炒通粉、柚子西多士、南瓜甜茶粿及雞屎藤茶粿，令人回味。北角一間獲米芝蓮推介的老字號上海食店，「爆汁」小籠包、「脆底」煎鍋貼及惹味擔擔麵，皆是必吃之選。施焯日帶陳若思走訪某大唱片公司的「飯堂」，品嚐謝霆鋒等紅星愛吃的化皮乳豬、蕎香生炒骨，別具風味。

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 排球名將蕭昌鴻於十多年前與梁浩賢結下師徒緣，及後助浩賢外闖職業球壇，到昌鴻進軍日本職排，二人有何深刻體會？單車小將仇斯雅從小受父親仇多明的薰陶下，追尋單車夢，早前還獲頒學生運動員獎項，兩父女細訴傳承之路。香港田徑公開賽，焦點重溫一百米、四百米跑的衝線時刻。慈善高爾夫球賽邀得郭晉安、洪永城等藝人參與表演賽，送上花絮。足球名帥高普召集多位球星，接受高難度球技挑戰。另帶來沙田龍舟競賽、先進游泳賽的戰報。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
廉政狙擊#8粵PG
programme.desc: 子峰遠赴他鄉尋找親姐姐，終發現屠敏就是子欣，得知姐姐曾經淪為童妓，子峰無比痛心。世邦跪求屠敏放他一馬，屠敏要求他離開，禁止他再踏足香港生事。子峰希望屠敏可以回家與母親相認，遭她冷漠地拒絕。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 奇蹟小店粵
programme.desc: 現今以機器生產為主的年代，一孖孖手工製的臘腸尤顯珍貴。位於西環海味街街角的臘味店，老闆兼第二代傳人堅持香港製造的這份信念，令舖頭一直獲街坊支持。店內的第二、第三代傳人縱於經營理念時有磨擦，但父子間的愛與尊重始終不變。另外，肥媽與羅啟豪走進年代久遠的茶行，內裡滿滿是別具價值的茶具用品。兩人坐下跟老闆品茗，細聽對方分享茶文化。店內師傅擁有一門以人手包茶的高超技藝，肥媽、啟豪嘗試學做，作品如何？

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 「鐵達尼號」於二十世紀初誕生，是當時世界上最大且正式投入營運的海上船舶。谷主瀅仴細述這艘夢幻巨輪的背景資料，以及它首航即沉沒的悲慘命運。事實上，鐵達尼號沉沒前曾多次接獲其他船隻發出的冰山警報，但船長一概無視，加上瞭望員失職，最終釀成世紀悲劇。這場海難曾被改編成愛情電影，谷主們分享最深刻情節，瀅仴與凱文更重演男、女主角船頭擁抱的經典一幕。談到觀影得着，她們認為電影中因貧富懸殊引發的階級觀念值得深思。

programme.title: 仨心友行 2粵
programme.desc: 玻璃屋旅程最後的第八天，諾懿請來好友陳敏之暫代其監製之職，督促三美炮製八人「愛的盛宴」；她們延續多日來培養的默契，煮理這個終極任務。嘉欣、子羚的閨密陳凱琳、周家蔚，以及君馨至愛陸續到臨。君馨兩口子旁若無人的狀態，更令敏之相當無奈……眾人品嚐愛的牛扒等美饌，凱琳、家蔚細談與嘉欣、子羚的相識緣分。這天原來是君馨和老公的結婚紀念日，諾懿為二人送上小驚喜。節目尾聲，三美逐一宣讀首天在字條許下的創業願望……

programme.title: 一個好人粵
programme.desc: 為守護環境可以付出多少？「貓哥」冼力求召集有心人深入被忽視的地方執垃圾，呼籲大家享受大自然的同時，也要懂得回報！走過石灘、山頭，子善再隨貓哥划獨木舟出海清理垃圾，竟越執越嬲？貓哥卻視之為運動鍛練！另一「好人」細傑透過義務搬屋、轉贈傢俬，關顧基層。某村曾受雨災重創，細傑二話不說將倉內傢俬轉贈，換來村民真誠感謝，他直言比金錢更重要！助人路途也曾遇貪心之人，他憶述受贈者將傢俬轉售，縱感無奈卻沒想過放棄。

programme.title: 一個好人粵
programme.desc: 因某次看到聽障人士練武，武術導師李安東決意創立輪椅武術隊，推動傷健共融理念。練武不只鍛練身體，也是心靈的修練，他還成功教出兩位有殘疾的跆拳道黑帶教練。子善跟兩教練上課，並細聽她們親訴藉武術走出正向人生的故事。中醫師林家揚會定期往離島探訪並義診，原來這是秉承父親的志向。除了子善隨行，林醫師亦帶同一眾小義工，為長者及有需要的人士送暖，更將藝術注入行善活動？家揚亦希望以身作則，鼓勵更多人向外界伸出援手。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: 本集的菜式是香辣牛腱，主持人教授怎樣煮得更香濃美味，就是保留汆水的肉湯，撈出雜質便可用來燜煮，除了平日的滷水口味，今天主持人特別採用蝦醬作為香味的來源，再加入椰奶及辣椒燜煮，就會成為又香又辣的香辣牛腱

programme.title: 翻生工程粵英
programme.desc: 工程師Rob Bell帶大家探討將廢棄結構轉變為未來建築背後的重大挑戰。

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 幽靈醫生
programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 不像三兄弟

programme.title: 彼得與狼奇遇記

programme.title: 彼得與狼奇遇記

programme.title: 粉紅色口紅
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠經典復仇之作好閨密為渣男反目成仇】因做錯抉擇導致人生本末倒置的女人，經過4次婚姻終於找到真愛與幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初戀情人當成全部，放棄了自己的夢想，卻得到徹頭徹尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫朴正宇，圖謀佳恩家的財富和地位與佳恩結婚，在達到目的後將佳恩拋棄，轉而和情人美蘭結婚，陰謀奪得了佳恩父親的公司，並間接害死了佳恩的父親。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步從一位百合般純潔的女人，變成了帶刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 逆轉女王
programme.desc: 【經典韓劇《賢內助女王》姊妹作】黃泰熙原是高薪的開發組長，但為了追求幸福家庭，她選擇與新同事奉俊秀結婚。然而她的決定，卻讓她被信任的女上司趕出公司，只能在家當賢內助。五年後，泰熙感到現實生活的沉重，決定重返職場。在公司她遇見了具勇植，一位支持她的本部長。泰熙在勇植的鼓勵下展現出更堅韌的一面，最終成功東山再起，找到了新的事業目標。

programme.title: 真愛OnAir
programme.desc: 【金荷娜《Onair》詮釋辛辣女星與編劇、導演、經紀人上演修羅場！】傲氣女星吳升雅外冷內熱，渴望被理解；毒舌編劇徐英恩辛辣犀利，因背叛築起心牆；導演李慶民冷面苛刻，與英恩有難解過往；經紀人張基俊圓融細膩，總在混亂中守住分寸。四人因同一部劇合作，從爭執、碰撞、試探，到逐漸看見彼此的脆弱與真心。升雅卸下武裝、英恩學會柔軟、慶民面對情感、基俊守住信念。他們不只拍戲，更在現場演繹真實人生。

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - Altamira
programme.desc: Chip y los átomos entran en una cueva llena de pinturas en las paredes. Una puerta bloquea el paso a la cueva en un lugar donde se apilan células de elementos químicos y un horno. Siguiendo las indicaciones de las pinturas y con la ayuda del libro de química de Chip, descubre que debe mezclar y fusionar varios elementos para crear unos zapatos de vidrio con los que pueda caminar sobre un suelo lleno de ácido, de modo que la puerta se levante y pueda seguir el camino. Cuando las antimaterias intentan seguirlo, mientras mezclan productos químicos, estos les aplastan la nariz.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La carga
programme.desc: Un transporte cargado de nitratos se dirige a la Torre Negra para que el Dr. No prepare explosivos. Chip se cuela en el transporte con la intención de ser llevado a su destino, pero al darse cuenta de la carga, hace todo lo posible para evitar que caiga en manos del malvado científico. Así, con la ayuda de átomos de bromo prisioneros, logra destruir el transporte y su peligrosa carga.

programme.title: Million Dollar Buffet S01 - EP1
programme.desc: The All You Eat Buffet is no longer about chicken chow mein and bad margarita pizza. This programme will visit the places where the luxury food is piled high.

programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Corn singing an A-maiz-ing Counting Song about his remarkably organised kernel rows.

programme.desc: Supertato and Evil Pea face each other in a dance-off so Supertato can rescue his friends.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Banana's Star Appeal
programme.desc: Supertato and Carrot help a superstar banana get his peel back from Evil Pea.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Bouncing
programme.desc: Laa-­Laa and Po drive in the Tubby Car to the Hidey Hup. They take turns on the Tubby Bouncy. Tinky Winky and Dipsy arrive and they have a go at bouncing too!

programme.title: Yakka Dee S06 - Ear
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'ear', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. Today we see lots of different ears - big, little, listening and funny ones. The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - Felix Finds His Voice
programme.desc: Messy the monster hears a chirping bird outside his window, but he can't understand what the bird is saying.

programme.desc: Mojo needs to deliver a pizza to a very hard-to-reach island, but some stubborn seabirds have their eye on the pizza. Will Mojo have to go supersonic to get past them?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Stickbird
programme.desc: On a trip to the beach, Mum teaches Bluey to throw, while Bingo and Dad get creative with a funny shaped stick.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Relax
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo would rather explore their holiday hotel room than relax on the beach.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Love Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee gets a card from someone he loves, the Squirrels ask: does he still love them? In a show-stopping song, Delivery Chipmunk shows them the answer is a resounding YES.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Shopping Badge
programme.desc: Duggee loves to shop local, so the Big Shop is a Big Deal for him. He's over-excited and wants two of everything. The Squirrels have to remind him 'we only popped in for milk!'

programme.desc: What’s that bouncy, pingy, whacking sound? It’s the Penguins playing ping-pong!

programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch makes popcorn in Mount Etna, Italy, he blocks the volcano and endangers farms on its slopes.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Zoo
programme.desc: Bluey's backyard zoo is home to wonderful animals, especially the big blue Daddy gorilla. But when he grabs visitor Bingo and escapes, Zookeeper Bluey must recapture the wild beast.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Double Babysitter
programme.desc: When Uncle Rad and Frisky accidentally turn up to babysit Bluey and Bingo on the same night, they have to work together to make Bluey feel better about babysitter putdowns.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Mini Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini-Bluey!

programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Cloud Kitchen, where Patch needs some help from the Playtimers to make hoopy owl bagels. It's time for a tasty adventure!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Tree Badge

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Transport Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee's old friend Rhodri goes home after a visit, he forgets his favourite hat. No worries, the Squirrels can run after him and give it back. They take all sorts of transport to catch Rhodri, and he is always one step ahead. Until finally, they're on a raft across the sea and land right by Rhodri's front door.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that 'finding their talents' means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Why Badge
programme.desc: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Sibling Badge
programme.desc: It's news time at the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels share their exciting news of the week with each other. Happy got a new bath sponge, Norrie is growing a sunflower and Roly, after thinking hard if he's got any news at all, remembers he's getting a new brother or sister. programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Transport Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee's old friend Rhodri goes home after a visit, he forgets his favourite hat. No worries, the Squirrels can run after him and give it back. They take all sorts of transport to catch Rhodri, and he is always one step ahead. Until finally, they're on a raft across the sea and land right by Rhodri's front door.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that 'finding their talents' means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Why Badge
programme.desc: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Sibling Badge
programme.desc: It's news time at the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels share their exciting news of the week with each other. Happy got a new bath sponge, Norrie is growing a sunflower and Roly, after thinking hard if he's got any news at all, remembers he's getting a new brother or sister. The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Andy and the Smooth Coated Otters

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that 'finding their talents' means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Why Badge
programme.desc: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Sibling Badge
programme.desc: It's news time at the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels share their exciting news of the week with each other. Happy got a new bath sponge, Norrie is growing a sunflower and Roly, after thinking hard if he's got any news at all, remembers he's getting a new brother or sister. The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing outside, when out of a bush jumps the cutest creature they ever did see. They think it is simply adorable and tell it so... with startling results. The creature bursts into tears! The creature, whose name is Plinky, tells them her whole family are monsters, and that's what she's supposed to be, but she just cannot get the hang of it. The Squirrels are keen to help Plinky get in touch with her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: Fan is cheated by her lover Tong to steal her master's Jade Dragon Sword. She is jailed in the Dragon Swamp as punishment and gave birth to a pair of twins - her daughter is raised by her master, while her son is taken by Tong. Twenty years later, the sword is stolen again and Fan's daughter goes seeking for it, meeting Fan's friend along the way.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Rolls, Rolls, I Love You
programme.desc: Three young men offend a billionaire and are drawn into a high stakes bet. If they win, they get to keep the billionaire's Rolls Royce. Otherwise, they will need to pay the rich man fifty thousand dollars! Will the underdogs win the bet?

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: Kung Fu legend Ti Lung stars in the action movie as Fu Xue Hong, embarking on a epic journey of revenge for his father.

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: Heroes Of Sung
programme.desc: Heroes Of Sung stars one of the original kung fu ladies of the silver screen, Shih Szu, who plays swordswoman Meng Hung. She must work with Fan Tien-Fu, played by Lo Lieh to find and protect the royal seals of the Sung Dynasty. Shih's magnificent performance earned her the female hero role in another hit Dracula And The 7 Golden Vampires.

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: Two feuding princes fight for the throne in the Qing Dynasty, causing many injuries and deaths to the commoners. Can the lady assassin who is drawn into this royal feud execute her assassination mission in time to help one of the princes secure the throne?

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off!

programme.title: Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off!

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: Roving Swordsman
programme.desc: An ambitious evil clan intends to rule the martial arts world. To achieve their goal, they must first steal a secret martial arts manuscript depicting how firearms can be produced. However, a supremely intelligent swordsman Shen Sheng Yi is protecting the manuscript and remains one step ahead of the evil clan.

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: Judgement of an Assassin
programme.desc: An evil clan plans a discord so as to dominate the martial arts world. Their masked assassins massacre another clan and one of the assassins is arrested and brought to trial at a tribunal of all the clans. What judgement will they make and can they uncover the truth?

programme.title: The Singing Thief
programme.desc: A master jewel thief turns over a new leaf as a professional singer in a nightclub. However, a series of robberies happened shortly after and he becomes the suspect again. The thief then sets up a trap to snare the copycat but will this backfire on him?

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chen's past insult.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huang's father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally beats Ouyang Ke to win Huang Rong back.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: The Magnificent Swordsman centres on the hero who vows vengeance against evil bandits who killed his family when he was a child. The hero recruits several friends to help the peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader of the band being the man who killed his family.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: This is a martial arts epic directed by Chang Cheh. In the Sung Dynasty, the government is run by corrupt officials, so Sung Jiang gathers 108 outlaws at Mount Liang and establishes a band of patriotic heroes to end the repression of brutal overlords.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Brave Archer And His Mate
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong raise the son of his sworn brother Yang Kang and named him Yang Guo. To prevent Yang Guo from taking revenge for his father's death, Huang Rong bans him from learning martial arts. Yang Guo runs away from home in anger and encounters Ouyang Feng, who teaches him the "Toad Stance" and accidentally unveils his true identity…

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: Portrait In Crystal
programme.desc: Tragic deaths in the underworld cause leader "Yama" (Teng Wei-hao) to suspect a portrait in crystal with mysterious powers. He sends Hen Pan (Chen Hung) and Pai Pan (Hung Hsin-nan) to interrogate its creator, martial artist Lung Fei (Pai Piao)...

programme.title: Godfather of Canton
programme.desc: A docker, Lin Si Hai, accidentally saves Commissioner Cheng who then offers him a position in the police force. Lin is smart and soon rises through the ranks through treachery and corruption, before becoming a gangster.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: Finger of Doom
programme.desc: The protagonists are ex-swordmasters who now find joy in making umbrellas. They track down the evil Madame Kung Sun and her poisonous "Finger of Doom", a unique supernatural power which allows her to transform normal, everyday people into horrifying zombies, and this is just the start of their mythical adventure against this zombie maker!

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li's new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Flying Dagger
programme.desc: The Yu family and the Green Dragon clan became enemies when the Yu daughter killed the clan head's son, who was a rapist and murderer. The Green Dragon leader wounds the head of the Yu family with his flying daggers, and a wandering swordsman saves the family using his own flying dagger skills. However, his allegiances and motives are unclear.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon could be called "Swordswomen Two." Three decades earlier, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu took on Shaw's first international superstar, Lo Lieh for the Han Family Sword - making this a four-star treat for action fans.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness &amp; innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: The Shaolin Avengers
programme.desc: Hu seeks to avenge his father who is being killed by the White-Browed Hermit and his gang. However, he fails in his attempt and is saved by Fang Shi Yu, a youth from Shaolin whose parents are also killed by the same villains. They learn and master the advanced Shaolin style kung fu, before Fang leads Hu and the Shaolin fellows to fight the enemies.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng's friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events...

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: God of Gamblers 2
programme.desc: After the God of Gamblers Ko Chun disappears, his disciple Little Knife rises in the gambling world. His fame attracts a ruthless rival who seeks to defeat him. Facing high-stakes games, Little Knife must rely on his skills to overcome his enemies and defend the honour of the God of Gamblers.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrant's plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own "Drunken Fist" style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team's downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: The Sorcerer &amp; The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip's boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim's sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist's drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter's company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle...

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master who left the martial arts world to protect his lover. However, his disappearance leads to her tragic death and as Liang Kun finds a way to survive in the martial arts world, he fights back to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandora's Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Liverpool vs Arsenal (MW03) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Liverpool are winless in six Premier League matches against Arsenal (D4 L2), their longest winless run against the Gunners since going eight without a win between October 2007 and April 2011.

programme.title: Manchester City vs Manchester United (MW04) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Manchester City have won five of their last eight Premier League matches against Manchester United (D1 L2), though they failed to win either game (D1 L1) last season for the first time since 2020-21.

programme.title: Chelsea vs Liverpool (MW07) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: After their 3-1 win in May, Chelsea could enjoy back-to-back league wins over Liverpool for the first time since November 2014 (3 in a row).

programme.title: Tottenham Hotspur vs Manchester United (MW11) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: The 34th season of the Premier League sees Liverpool defend its title against a host of teams keen for glory themselves. 20 teams are in the mix but only 1 champion will emerge ultimately.

programme.title: Arsenal vs Manchester City (MW05) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Arsenal have won two of their last four league meetings with Manchester City (D2), as many as their previous 22 beforehand (D5 L15). The Gunners could win back-to-back league games against the Citizens for the first time since December 2015.

programme.title: Liverpool vs Manchester United (MW08) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Manchester United are winless in their last eight Premier League away games (D2 L6) since beating Leicester City 3-0 in March. The Red Devils last went longer without a league win on the road in September 1989 under Alex Ferguson (11).

programme.title: Manchester City vs Liverpool (MW11) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Liverpool won this exact fixture 2-0 last season but haven’t won consecutive away league games against Man City since a run of three between 1987 and 1991.

programme.title: Manchester City vs Liverpool (MW11) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Liverpool won this exact fixture 2-0 last season but haven’t won consecutive away league games against Man City since a run of three between 1987 and 1991.

programme.title: Arsenal vs Tottenham Hotspur (MW12) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Arsenal have won five of their last six Premier League games against Tottenham (D1), including the last three in a row. It’s their longest winning run against Spurs since a five game stretch between January 1987 and January 1989.

programme.title: Tottenham Hotspur vs Liverpool (MW17) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Tottenham have won just two of their last 25 Premier League games against Liverpool (D6 L17), picking up home wins in October 2017 (4-1) and September 2023 (2-1).

programme.title: Arsenal vs Manchester United (MW23) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Manchester United are winless in their last six Premier League games against Arsenal (D1 L5) – they’ve never gone seven in a row without a win against the Gunners in their league history.

programme.title: Liverpool vs Manchester City (MW25) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Following their 3-0 win at the Etihad in November, Manchester City are looking to complete their first league double over Liverpool since 1936-37, which was also the last time they won consecutive league games against them.

programme.title: Tottenham Hotspur vs Manchester City (MW24) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Tottenham have completed the Premier League double over Manchester City nine times so far, more than they have any other opponent. Meanwhile, only Chelsea (10) have done so more against the Citizens.

programme.title: Newcastle United vs Sunderland (MW31) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Sunderland are unbeaten in their last 10 league games against Newcastle (W7 D3), winning seven of the last eight. It’s the joint-longest run either side has had without defeat in the history of the fixture (Newcastle also 10 between 1985 and 1997).

programme.title: Tottenham Hotspur vs Arsenal (MW27) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Spurs have lost their last three Premier League home games against Arsenal, as many as they had in their previous 23 (W10 D10). They last lost four in a row against them between 1952 and 1955.

programme.title: Chelsea vs Manchester City (MW32) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Chelsea are winless in their last nine Premier League games against Man City (D3 L6) since a 2-1 away win in May 2021.

programme.title: Everton vs Liverpool (MW33) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Everton have won just one of their last 14 Premier League home games against Liverpool, though 10 of those games have finished level (L3).

programme.title: Manchester United vs Liverpool (MW35) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Manchester United have won just three of their last 19 Premier League games against Liverpool (D9 L7), though are looking to complete the league double over the Reds for the first time since 2015-16.

programme.title: Manchester City vs Arsenal (MW33) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Manchester City are unbeaten in their last 10 Premier League home games against Arsenal (W7 D3) since a 2-0 loss in January 2015 under Manuel Pellegrini.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S12 - Bubble Bass's Tab

programme.title: Danger Force S2 - Alien Zoo

programme.title: Henry Danger S5 - Henry's Birthday
programme.desc: While trying to celebrate his birthday, Henry keeps getting interrupted by crimes going on in Swellview.
